source_note: FIX 2026-10-04: total assets read 1,004,749 in BOTH FY2025 and FY2024 (~6x low) and the non-current/current components did not sum to it. Rebuilt from stockanalysis.com NGX:DANGCEM balance sheet (millions NGN x1e6), whose FY2025 total assets 6,040,727m and FY2024 6,403,238m reproduce Dangote Cement's own filed FY2025/FY2024 statements; FY2023 non-current assets 2,529,711m ties to the issuer's 9M-2024 statement. Total liabilities/equity populated for FY2025 (3,420,591 / 2,620,136) and FY2024 (4,227,993 / 2,175,245) so assets = liabilities + equity holds. Older-period liabilities/equity left blank: not established from a source.
